name: harness-neutral wording
claim: Under strat-serial-3.0 no text the harness gives a model (core prompt, tool definitions, tool results, injected turns, helper prompts) contains an identifying term, so a model cannot tell from it what runs it; the strategies registered before it keep their original wording.

models.result: Checks pass: every request variant buildRequest makes, the helper prompts kept as module data, the watcher's and filter's prompts as sent, a whole session request with shell and local_* results, and the failure texts hold none of the 12 terms of app/neutral.js. Changed in place: descriptions of shell, concern_file, local_info, local_http, local_read; the not-configured answer of the local tools; the watcher's system line; one line of the scratch helper's prompt; shell and local tool failures now read plainly. Known residue: inside the in-page machine wh-install, WH_SHELF, ~/.wh and the placeholder token name are still there to be found by a command; the scratch helper's prompt names Alpine and wh-install; a model that reads app/tools.js can match its own tool list. Not measured: whether a real model can name what runs it.

2026-11-20: the in-place rewording (aa62df3) is undone for every registered strategy and becomes the data of strat-serial-3.0 (wording: neutral). strat-serial-1.0, checkpoint-1.0, stem-1.0 and stem-2.0 send the pre-aa62df3 tool definitions byte for byte; serial-2.0 differs from 1.0 only in output_read and repo_read; serial-3.0 differs from 2.0 only in shell, concern_file and local_*; the local tools answer, the watcher line and the scratch line follow the strategy. Residue: failure texts of the shell and local tools stay plain under every strategy; strat-serial-2.0 was registered after aa62df3, so its bytes at registration were the neutral ones (the judge defined 2.0 as 1.0 plus ranged reads).

means: The documented words that would tell a model what runs it; under strat-serial-3.0 no text the harness gives a model contains one.
Strategy field wording: absent sends descriptions and helper lines as first registered; neutral (strat-serial-3.0) names nothing of what runs the tools.
Setting hostFiles: a session whose shell runs on a host also gets file_read, file_edit and file_write there, through the exec route.
Setting toolRounds: model-tool round trips in one user turn before the turn stops as limit; default 8 (MAX_STEPS), branches keep 8.

name: host file tools
claim: A session whose shell runs on a host, given exact file read, edit and write tools there, changes files without patch scripts and reads regions without head-and-tail views or output_read calls.

models.result: 2026-11-20, real bridge on Windows, WSL user (wsl:) and container (wsl-podman:), scratch folders under /tmp removed after: LF, CRLF, BOM plus non-ASCII with mixed endings, and a 338,781-byte file round-trip byte for byte through write and edit (sha256 on the target); per call median read 0.36 s / 2.1 s, edit 0.66 s / 4.3 s (a read and a write), 300 KB edit 1.3 s / 4.7 s, against 0.34 s / 2.1 s for a bare shell call; a 60-line range of the 300 KB file came back whole (3,417 chars), a whole read is cut at 40,000 chars at a line end and names the lines left; absent and repeated find are classed find-absent and find-ambiguous; .., absolute paths elsewhere and a link leaving the folder are refused. Not measured: a real model.
models.evidence: scripts/test-localbridge.mjs (host files); docs/concepts/HYPOTHESES.md (Host files, tool rounds and run code)

name: tool rounds per turn
claim: A round limit set per profile or session above 8 removes the limit stops and bare continue messages a long host-shell task needed, without a different outcome.

models.result: 2026-11-20: toolRounds 3 stops a turn after 3 tool rounds, recorded as limit, the notice names 3; default unset is 8 as before; validated 1..100 in Paste config, the scope grid and the profile card. Not measured: a real model at a higher limit.

name: host shell backend
claim: A session's shell tool can run on a host exec target (WSL user or container) while its name, schema, description and result shape stay byte-identical to the in-browser machine; under strat-serial-3.0 nothing it is sent names where its tools are served from.

models.result: Real bridge on Windows, 2026-11-20, targets wsl: (user wh) and wsl-podman: (container wh-dev, user dev); all 38 checks of the run held (both targets, the limits, and the page). Per call about 0.35 s (wsl) and 1.8 s (container). node --check app/main.js status 0; git status --short status 0; exit 7 with both streams in order; 3 s timeout answered in 3.3 s / 4.7 s with no process left in the distro or the container; dropped request stopped; 1.3 MB whole, 21 MB cut at 4,000,000 and marked; fifth concurrent call refused. From the page: tools and first message byte-identical on both targets; result text the same as the machine's. Limits found: a container whose process 1 does not reap keeps stopped commands' children as defunct entries (start it with --init); the tmux option could not be switched on with the in-page machine off until vmTmux became a Paste config field; with tmux each command is still its own bash (cd and export do not carry), as in the in-page machine. Not measured: a real model, docker, a Linux-run bridge against a container, macOS.

first real model run, 2026-11-20: container target (wsl-podman), 119 shell calls over 125 requests, task completed with 3 commits and the suites green, $0.01206; first request held none of the terms that name the harness or a browser; found: no retry on a provider 502, run_js runs elsewhere than the shell (4 of 5 calls errors), no edit tool for host files, shell results over about 1,500 chars need output_read, the 8-round stop cut the work 14 times

2026-11-20 follow-up to the first real run: file_read, file_edit and file_write on the host (setting hostFiles, off by default); run_js left out of a host session with the existing run code capability (deny at profile or session), chosen over routing it to node on the host (no node dependency; the shell already runs node); toolRounds as a setting; VIEW_MAX left at 1,500. With hostFiles on, run code denied and strat-serial-3.0 the first request offers 19 tools and holds none of WebHarness, browser, page, tab, bridge, Alpine, wh-install, harness, in-page. Under older strategies the shell description names the page, so such a session should use strat-serial-3.0. Bridge: the exec cwd is letters, digits and . _ - / only; a local: command gets a small environment.
models.evidence: docs/concepts/HYPOTHESES.md (Host files, tool rounds and run code); README.md#host-shell-the-shell-tool-on-a-host-of-yours
